title: Subquery in WHERE Clause
description: Find employees earning above the average salary using a subquery.

data.text: Write a query to find all employees whose salary is above the average salary of all employees.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT EmployeeID, FirstName, LastName, Salary
FROM Employees
WHERE Salary > (
    SELECT AVG(Salary)
    FROM Employees
)
ORDER BY Salary DESC;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: A scalar subquery returns a single value. The inner SELECT AVG(Salary) computes the average salary once. Each outer row is compared against this single value. This is a non-correlated subquery — it does not reference outer table columns.
